annotation.interpretation_a: The implementation is permitted to retransmit the STOP_SENDING frame even if the stream is closed, but can choose not to.
annotation.interpretation_b: The implementation is permitted to *not* retransmit the STOP_SENDING frame if the stream is closed, and there is no requirement to retransmit it at all.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY choose not to" creates ambiguity. Does this mean the implementation can still retransmit, but is allowed to avoid doing so, or does it mean the implementation is not required to retransmit under those conditions? The difference affects how an implementation would handle a lost STOP_SENDING frame and whether it would continue to attempt retransmission.
